stem: Plant debris from a suspect area must be removed. What is the best general approach?
choices: Use the site's controlled containment and waste-movement route to avoid spreading material through cleaner zones
Carry it uncovered through the shortest route
Mix it with clean supplies to reduce trips
Stage it in propagation until the waste area is available
rationale: Plant debris can carry contamination. Controlled containment and movement reduce the chance of connecting high-risk material to cleaner areas.
